Tiring cycle a brief notice for customers
Please read this before you travel
Travelers with pets should check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk early and keep all travel papers ready.

Pet travel notice

Our cabin team keeps an eye on animals during flight and passes along any service changes to the desk ledger. That helps us stay aligned with crews and keep each trip steady for you and your companion. If your animal needs special handling, tell us before you head to the gate so we can note it clearly and share the right guidance.

Please pack familiar items in a simple bag, use approved carriers, and make sure tags are secure. Calm pets travel best, so keep your routine low-key and follow any instructions from the desk or the cabin team. We handle updates in plain words and keep the process practical.

If you are traveling with Ben Muller, Marcus Bianchi, or Ginger, bring the same care and document checks as for any other trip. For any last-minute change, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
